10
Yesu ne Odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no
1 Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, deɛ ɔmfa ɛpono ano nkɔ nnwammuo mu na ɔforo fa baabi no, ɔyɛ owifoɔ ne odwotwafoɔ; 2na deɛ ɔfa ɛpono ano kɔ mu no ne nnwan no hwɛfoɔ. 3Ɔno na ɛponoanohwɛfoɔ hini ma no, na nnwan no te ne nne, na ɔbɔ ɔno ara ne nnwan din frɛ wɔn firi adi. 4Na ɔma ɔno ara ne nnwan firi adi a, ɔdi wɔn anim; na nnwan no di n’akyi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnim ne nne. 5Na ɔhɔhoɔ deɛ, wɔrenni n’akyi, na wɔbɛdwane no; ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnim ananafoɔ nne. 6Yesu de bɛ yi buu wɔn; na wɔn deɛ, wɔanhunu asɛm ko a ɔkaa wɔn no.
Nnwammuo ano pono
7Ɛnna Yesu see wɔn bio sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mene nnwan no pono no. 8#Yer 23.1-2 Wɔn a wɔdii m’anim baeɛ no nyinaa yɛ awifoɔ ne adwotwafoɔ; na nnwan no antie wɔn. 9Mene ɛpono no; sɛ obi fa me so kɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na ɔbɛkɔ mu, na ɔbɛfiri adi, na ɔbɛnya adidibea. 10#Dwom 23.1 Owifoɔ mma, gye sɛ ɔrebɛwia na wakum na wasɛe; me deɛ, mebae, na wɔanya nkwa, na wɔanya no mmorosoɔ.
Odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no
11 # Yes 40.11; Hes 34.11-23; 37.24; Yoh 15.13 Mene odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no. Odwanhwɛfoɔ pa de ne nkwa to hɔ ma nnwan no; 12na ɔpaani a ɔnyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ, na nnwan no nyɛ ne dea no hunu pataku sɛ ɔreba a, ɔgya nnwan no hɔ dwane; na pataku no bɛkye wɔn bɔ wɔn hwete. 13Na ɔpaani dwane, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔpaani, na ɔnnwene nnwan no ho. 14#2 Ti 2.19 Mene odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no; na menim me deɛ, na me deɛ nso nim me, 15#Mat 11.27 sɛdeɛ Agya no nim me, na me nso menim Agya no. Na mede me nkwa meto hɔ mema nnwan no. 16#Yoh 11.52 Na mewɔ nnwan foforɔ a wɔmfiri ban yi mu; wɔn nso na ɛtwa sɛ mede wɔn meba, na wɔbɛtie me nne, na ayɛ kuo baako ne ɔhwɛfoɔ baako.
17 Yei nti na Agya no dɔ me, ɛfiri sɛ mede me nkwa meto hɔ, na mafa bio. 18#Yoh 5.26 Obi nnye me nsam, na me ara na mede meto hɔ; na mewɔ ho kwan sɛ mede meto hɔ, na mewɔ ho kwan sɛ mefa bio; ahyɛdeɛ yi na menyaa no m’Agya nkyɛn. 19#Yoh 7.43; 9.16 Ɛnna nsɛm yi nti mpaepaemu baa Yudafoɔ no mu bio. 20#Yoh 7.20 Na wɔn mu bebree kaa sɛ: Ɔwɔ honhommɔne, na wabɔ dam; adɛn nti na motie no? 21Ebinom se: Nsɛm yi nyɛ deɛ ɔwɔ honhommɔne nsɛm. Honhommɔne bɛtumi abue anifirafoɔ ani anaa?
Yesu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ
22Na Asɔrefiedwira afahyɛ adu wɔ Yerusalem, na awɔ berɛ aba. 23#Aso 3.11 Na Yesu nenam asɔrefie Salomo abrannaa so. 24Ɛnna Yudafoɔ bɛtwaa ne ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔsee no sɛ: Wobɛma yɛatwɛn akɔsi da bɛn? Sɛ wone Kristo no a, pae mu ka kyerɛ yɛn pefee? 25#Yoh 5.36 Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Maka makyerɛ mo, na monnye nni; nnwuma a meyɛ no m’Agya din mu no, ɛno na ɛdi me ho adanseɛ. 26#Yoh 8.45 Na mo deɛ, monnye nni; ɛfiri sɛ momfiri me nnwan no mu. 27#Yoh 10.3-4; 8.47 Me nnwan tie me nne, na me nso menim wɔn, na wɔdi m’akyi; 28na mema wɔn daa nkwa, na wɔrenyera, na obi renhwim wɔn mfiri me nsam da. 29M’Agya a ɔde wɔn maa me no yɛ kɛseɛ sene nnoɔma nyinaa; na obi rentumi nhwim wɔn m’Agya nsam. 30Me ne Agya no yɛ baako.
Yudafoɔ no pɛ sɛ wɔkum Yesu
31 # Yoh 8.59 Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no tasee aboɔ bio sɛ wɔde rebɛsi no. 32Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Nnwuma pa pii na mayɛ makyerɛ mo a ɛfiri Agya no nkyɛn; emu deɛ ɛwɔ he nti na morebɛsi me aboɔ yi? 33#Yoh 5.18; Mat 26.65 Yudafoɔ no buaa no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ adwuma pa nti na yɛrebɛsi wo aboɔ, na abususɛm ntira, ɛfiri sɛ wo a woyɛ onipa no yɛ wo ho sɛ Onyankopɔn. 34#Dwom 82.6 Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Wɔntwerɛɛ no mo mmara mu sɛ: Mekaa sɛ: Moyɛ anyame? 35Sɛ ɔfrɛɛ wɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm baa wɔn nkyɛn no anyame na wɔntumi nsɛe atwerɛ no a, 36#Yoh 5.17-20 adɛn nti na moka deɛ Agya ayɛ no kronkron, na wasoma no wiase no ho sɛ: Woka abususɛm, ɛnam sɛ mekaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn Ba ne me? 37Sɛ menyɛ m’Agya nnwuma a, ɛnneɛ monnnye me nnni; 38na sɛ meyɛ, na me deɛ, monnye me nni a, monnye nnwuma no nni, na moahwɛ ahunu sɛ Agya no wɔ me mu, na me nso mewɔ ne mu. 39#Yoh 8.59; Luk 4.30 Ɛnna wɔhwehwɛɛ bio sɛ wɔkye no, na ɔfiri wɔn nsa kɔe.
Yesu twa kɔ Yordan agya
40 # Yoh 1.28 Na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Yordan agya nohoa bio wɔ faako a Yohane bɔɔ asu kane no, na ɔkɔtenaa hɔ. 41Na nnipa pii baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔkaa sɛ: Yohane anyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi deɛ, nanso nnoɔma a Yohane kaa wɔ oyi ho nyinaa no yɛ nokorɛ. 42Na nnipa pii gyee no dii wɔ hɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, deɛ ɔmfa ɛpono ano nkɔ nnwammuo mu na ɔforo fa baabi no, ɔyɛ owifoɔ ne odwotwafoɔ; na deɛ ɔfa ɛpono ano kɔ mu no ne nnwan no hwɛfoɔ. Ɔno na ɛponoanohwɛfoɔ hini ma no, na nnwan no te ne nne, na ɔbɔ ɔno ara ne nnwan din frɛ wɔn firi adi. Na ɔma ɔno ara ne nnwan firi adi a, ɔdi wɔn anim; na nnwan no di n’akyi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnim ne nne. Na ɔhɔhoɔ deɛ, wɔrenni n’akyi, na wɔbɛdwane no; ɛfiri sɛ wɔnnim ananafoɔ nne. Yesu de bɛ yi buu wɔn; na wɔn deɛ, wɔanhunu asɛm ko a ɔkaa wɔn no.

Ɛnna Yesu see wɔn bio sɛ: Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Mene nnwan no pono no. Wɔn a wɔdii m’anim baeɛ no nyinaa yɛ awifoɔ ne adwotwafoɔ; na nnwan no antie wɔn. Mene ɛpono no; sɛ obi fa me so kɔ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa, na ɔbɛkɔ mu, na ɔbɛfiri adi, na ɔbɛnya adidibea. Owifoɔ mma, gye sɛ ɔrebɛwia na wakum na wasɛe; me deɛ, mebae, na wɔanya nkwa, na wɔanya no mmorosoɔ.

Mene odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no. Odwanhwɛfoɔ pa de ne nkwa to hɔ ma nnwan no; na ɔpaani a ɔnyɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ, na nnwan no nyɛ ne dea no hunu pataku sɛ ɔreba a, ɔgya nnwan no hɔ dwane; na pataku no bɛkye wɔn bɔ wɔn hwete. Na ɔpaani dwane, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ ɔpaani, na ɔnnwene nnwan no ho. Mene odwanhwɛfoɔ pa no; na menim me deɛ, na me deɛ nso nim me, sɛdeɛ Agya no nim me, na me nso menim Agya no. Na mede me nkwa meto hɔ mema nnwan no. Na mewɔ nnwan foforɔ a wɔmfiri ban yi mu; wɔn nso na ɛtwa sɛ mede wɔn meba, na wɔbɛtie me nne, na ayɛ kuo baako ne ɔhwɛfoɔ baako.
Yei nti na Agya no dɔ me, ɛfiri sɛ mede me nkwa meto hɔ, na mafa bio. Obi nnye me nsam, na me ara na mede meto hɔ; na mewɔ ho kwan sɛ mede meto hɔ, na mewɔ ho kwan sɛ mefa bio; ahyɛdeɛ yi na menyaa no m’Agya nkyɛn. Ɛnna nsɛm yi nti mpaepaemu baa Yudafoɔ no mu bio. Na wɔn mu bebree kaa sɛ: Ɔwɔ honhommɔne, na wabɔ dam; adɛn nti na motie no? Ebinom se: Nsɛm yi nyɛ deɛ ɔwɔ honhommɔne nsɛm. Honhommɔne bɛtumi abue anifirafoɔ ani anaa?

Na Asɔrefiedwira afahyɛ adu wɔ Yerusalem, na awɔ berɛ aba. Na Yesu nenam asɔrefie Salomo abrannaa so. Ɛnna Yudafoɔ bɛtwaa ne ho hyiaeɛ, na wɔsee no sɛ: Wobɛma yɛatwɛn akɔsi da bɛn? Sɛ wone Kristo no a, pae mu ka kyerɛ yɛn pefee? Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Maka makyerɛ mo, na monnye nni; nnwuma a meyɛ no m’Agya din mu no, ɛno na ɛdi me ho adanseɛ. Na mo deɛ, monnye nni; ɛfiri sɛ momfiri me nnwan no mu. Me nnwan tie me nne, na me nso menim wɔn, na wɔdi m’akyi; na mema wɔn daa nkwa, na wɔrenyera, na obi renhwim wɔn mfiri me nsam da. M’Agya a ɔde wɔn maa me no yɛ kɛseɛ sene nnoɔma nyinaa; na obi rentumi nhwim wɔn m’Agya nsam. Me ne Agya no yɛ baako.

Ɛnna Yudafoɔ no tasee aboɔ bio sɛ wɔde rebɛsi no. Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Nnwuma pa pii na mayɛ makyerɛ mo a ɛfiri Agya no nkyɛn; emu deɛ ɛwɔ he nti na morebɛsi me aboɔ yi? Yudafoɔ no buaa no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ adwuma pa nti na yɛrebɛsi wo aboɔ, na abususɛm ntira, ɛfiri sɛ wo a woyɛ onipa no yɛ wo ho sɛ Onyankopɔn. Yesu buaa wɔn sɛ: Wɔntwerɛɛ no mo mmara mu sɛ: Mekaa sɛ: Moyɛ anyame? Sɛ ɔfrɛɛ wɔn a Nyankopɔn asɛm baa wɔn nkyɛn no anyame na wɔntumi nsɛe atwerɛ no a, adɛn nti na moka deɛ Agya ayɛ no kronkron, na wasoma no wiase no ho sɛ: Woka abususɛm, ɛnam sɛ mekaa sɛ: Nyankopɔn Ba ne me? Sɛ menyɛ m’Agya nnwuma a, ɛnneɛ monnnye me nnni; na sɛ meyɛ, na me deɛ, monnye me nni a, monnye nnwuma no nni, na moahwɛ ahunu sɛ Agya no wɔ me mu, na me nso mewɔ ne mu. Ɛnna wɔhwehwɛɛ bio sɛ wɔkye no, na ɔfiri wɔn nsa kɔe.

Na ɔsii mu kɔɔ Yordan agya nohoa bio wɔ faako a Yohane bɔɔ asu kane no, na ɔkɔtenaa hɔ. Na nnipa pii baa ne nkyɛn, na wɔkaa sɛ: Yohane anyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi deɛ, nanso nnoɔma a Yohane kaa wɔ oyi ho nyinaa no yɛ nokorɛ. Na nnipa pii gyee no dii wɔ hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
